question.text: When a spring is stretched by $10 \mathrm{cm}$, the potential energy stored is $E$. When the spring is stretched by $10 \mathrm{cm}$ more, the potential energy stored in the spring becomes

solution.text:
For 1st situation,
$$
E=\frac{1}{2} k\left(10 \times 10^{-2}\right)^{2}
$$
For 2nd situation,
$$
E^{\prime}=\frac{1}{2} k\left(20 \times 10^{-2}\right)^{2}
$$
On comparing Eqs. (i) and (ii), we get
$$
E^{\prime}=4 E
$$
